heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated—

tree.text: to the Secretary of the Interior to carry out this chapter—

children.text: $5,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2023 through 2025;

tree.text: to the Secretary of Agriculture to carry out this chapter—

children.text: $5,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2023 through 2025; and

tree.text: to the Secretary of the Army to carry out this chapter—

children.text: $2,500,000 for each of fiscal years 2023 through 2025.
